insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Vi is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Vi in 33/71 games (46%): 12 picks (10-2) and 21 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Rumble? They go Sion
insights.text: Rumble is a G1 favorite (11/30 G1s, played by Canna). In the 29 later games where it was burned or banned, Canna went to Sion (4/29) and Aurora (3/29).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 22 G3+ games, 42/110 picks (38%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 48 champs in G1s, 54 in G3+.
